voice.replaceOrAppend: Text transcribed. Review or edit below.
voice.micPermissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Please allow microphone access in browser settings.
voice.micNotSupported: Voice recording is not supported in this browser.
voice.transcriptionFailed: Voice transcription failed. Please try again or type manually.

errors.MICROPHONE_PERMISSION_DENIED: Microphone access was denied. Please allow microphone permissions in your browser settings and try again.
errors.RECORDING_FAILED: Audio recording could not be processed. Please try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_BROWSER: Voice recording is not supported on this browser or device.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_FORMAT: The recorded audio format is not supported by your browser.
errors.EMPTY_AUDIO: The recording was empty. Please try speaking into your microphone.
errors.AUDIO_TOO_SHORT: The recording was too short. Please speak for at least 1-2 seconds.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: Could not connect to the voice transcription service. Please check your internet connection.
errors.EDGE_FUNCTION_FAILED: Voice processing is temporarily unavailable. You can type your response instead.
errors.GEMINI_API_FAILED: AI transcription is temporarily unavailable. You can type your response instead.
errors.NO_SPEECH_DETECTED: The recording was received, but speech could not be detected. Please try speaking clearly.
errors.LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The spoken language could not be recognized as one of the supported Indic languages.
errors.LOW_CONFIDENCE_TRANSCRIPTION: The audio was unclear. Please review the transcription or record again.
errors.TRANSLATION_FAILED: Speech transcribed, but translation encountered an error.
errors.INVALID_AI_RESPONSE: Invalid response received from transcription engine. Please try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: We could not transcribe the audio recording. Please try again or type instead.

infrastructure.reviewDescription: This issue has been classified for capital infrastructure assessment and is currently undergoing administrative screening using district baseline data and sectoral planning baselines.

infrastructure.passedSubtitle: This infrastructure request has successfully passed administrative screening.

infrastructure.disclaimer: This is an official administrative screening decision recorded by an authorized CivicFix administrator.
